title.zh: 统一公共学校局、职业教育局、私立学校局、国家教育委员会与教育部总办公室各局长、助理局长、行政官员与主管的薪金
title.en: An Act to Standardize the Salaries of Directors, Assistant Directors, Administrative Officers and Superintendents in the General Offices of the Bureau of Public Schools, Bureau of Vocational Education, Bureau of Private Schools the Board of National Education and the Department of Education
title.orig: An Act to Standardize the Salaries of Directors, Assistant Directors, Administrative Officers and Superintendents in the General Offices of the Bureau of Public Schools, Bureau of Vocational Education, Bureau of Private Schools the Board of National Education and the Department of Education

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 3 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1964/ra_4151_1964.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en:
Provisions of the existing laws to the contrary notwithstanding, the minimum salaries of Directors, Assistant Directors, Administrative Officers, and Superintendents in the General Offices of the Bureau of Public Schools, Bureau of Vocational Education, Bureau of Private Schools, Board of National Education and Department of Education are hereby fixed as follows:
(a) Director .......................................................................................
₱16,044.00 per annum
(b) Assistant Director .......................................................................
14,532.00 per annum (c)Administrative officer III to VI .......................................................
9,288 to 12,516.00 per annum
(d) Superintendent III or chief of division .........................................
12,516.00 per annum
(e) Superintendent II or chief of division ..........................................
11,328.00 per annum
(f) Superintendent I or chief of division ............................................
10,240.00 per annum
(g) Superintendent III or assistant chief of division ..........................
11,904.00 per annum
(h) Superintendent II or assistant chief of division............................
10,776.00 per annum
(i) Superintendent I or assistant chief of division .............................
9,736.00 per annum
(j) Superintendent I to III ..................................................................
9,288 to 11,328.00 per annum

Such sums as are necessary to implement this Act in fiscal year ending June thirty, nineteen hundred sixty-four, are hereby appropriated from the savings of the bureaus and offices mentioned in Section one of the Act. Thereafter, the necessary funds for the purpose shall be included in the annual General Appropriations Act.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved, June 20, 1964.
